comment: What run-interface-label-fit.py finds in windows and panels that have not been fixed yet. These are printed and do not fail the check. A problem not listed here fails it, and so does a listed one that is no longer found: remove it from the list. Compiled variants of a nib are written as *, and a window at its smallest size as (smallest size). A group marked intermittent may be missing without failing.
